translations.web: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.
translations.bsb: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
translations.kjv: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
translations.asv: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each board.
